summary: Seritage Growth Properties filed an 8-K on July 24, 2026, disclosing new credit facilities with b1Bank: a $15 million term loan and a $25 million revolving line (initial draw $15M, $10M available). Proceeds, with cash, repaid the $50M balance of the original $1.6B senior secured loan from Berkshire Hathaway. New facilities mature July 24, 2028, with one-year extensions, SOFR-based pricing, and full prepayment optionality. This refinancing reduces debt and modifies capital structure, implying ongoing balance-sheet restructuring. Watch future asset sales or further refinancing to meet obligations.
